text:
Mia Ramos: FYI, Acme Ops just hit a bunch of 401s immediately after our scheduled API-key rotation in us-west.
Acme Ops: seeing 401s for all requests, started ~12:06 UTC right after you said rotation complete. No code changes on our side.
Mia Ramos: rough. Do we have a log sample from them? Any common client type (serverless, mobile, etc.)?
Acme Ops: mostly serverless (Vercel functions) and a couple of long-running worker processes. Header shown: Authorization: Bearer <old-key>
Lina Chen: can you paste a log line? Are they hitting the gateway or the auth service directly?
Acme Ops: here — `2026-03-12T12:06:08Z ERROR auth: token invalid user=acme-service role=ingest remote=34.82.11.4` — they get 401 with body { "error": "invalid_api_key" }
Owen Patel: confirmed on our side: rotation job marked old key revoked immediately. We intended to enable a 1-hour grace window but the flag didn't get toggled due to a config merge conflict.
Mia Ramos: ugh. So old keys were removed without a grace period. That explains immediate failures.
Owen Patel: reproducer for others: curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <old-key>" -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/complete -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' — returns 401 when legacy acceptance is off.
Lina Chen: workaround: we can enable `accept_legacy_keys=true` on the api-proxy tier which will accept keys revoked within the last hour while we coordinate updates.
deploy-bot: deploy request accepted — enabling feature toggle `accept_legacy_keys=true` on service api-proxy/us-west-canary
Mia Ramos: I told Acme to rotate and restart their workers, but they need time. Can we re-enable old-key acceptance ASAP and then schedule a rolling rollback of the rotation flag?
Owen Patel: yes. I'll promote the canary change to prod. Expected impact: ~30s to take effect, minimal risk. We'll also add an audit event for immediate revocations.
Acme Ops: thanks — will start restarting instances, ETA ~15min. Any tip for serverless where env var updates are slow to propagate?
Lina Chen: serverless note: many platforms cache env vars for function instances until cold-start. Recommend creating a new key, deploy that config, then revoke the old key after confirmation. Short-term: restarting all active instances forces pickup.
Mia Ramos: sending them a short repro/checklist:

1) Verify current key in their environment: `echo $API_KEY` on the runtime or dump header captured in logs.
2) Try direct curl with the new key: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <new-key>" https://api.redwood.example/v1/health` — expect 200.
3) Restart any long-running processes and redeploy serverless functions to pick up env var.
4) If still 401, capture `X-Request-ID` from the response and send to support for tracing.

Owen Patel: root cause action items:
- Re-enable legacy acceptance immediately (done)
- Add a migration checklist to the rotation runbook to create new key before revoking old key
- Update rotation tooling to atomically enable grace window during rotate and ensure merge checks
- Add SLO to validate key-acceptance toggle during canaries

Lina Chen: infra ops: we should also add a small delay (configurable) between key revoke and permanent deletion, plus an audit log for manual revokes.
Mia Ramos: Acme confirmation: `we're running new key tests now, errors dropped to 0 after a couple restarts. thanks! :relieved:`
Owen Patel: follow-ups: I'll open a tiny docs PR with the serverless note and update the support runbook. Lina will make the rotation flag non-merge-blocking but part of the CI checks.
Mia Ramos: assigning follow-ups and sending customer close note in ~24h to confirm nothing else pops up.
Acme Ops: appreciated — happy to help test the improved rotation flow once it's ready. :thumbsup:
